title: High-resolution Reference-only extension to R512 and optional R1024
scientific_question: Does the weak spatial-refinement progress observed through R256 continue at R512 and R1024, and does the descriptive adjacent-grid convergence order stabilize rather than remain near zero?

workload.forcing: exact C5A gravity-consistent qeq and 0.875/1.125 prescribed-head factors
workload.numerical_policy: exact C5A-C5D pre-existing D13 integrated-water-depth policy

secondary_new.failure_rule: retain exact qualification failure and continue without policy changes

known_pre_response_baseline.interpretation: Two adjacent-grid reductions exist but are weak. These observed values motivate rather than determine C5E outcome.

primary: adjacent-grid signed-error decomposition by history and phase
stabilization_reading: whether R512-R1024 < R256-R512 if R1024 qualifies
whether the descriptive order increases, remains comparable, or collapses relative to the preceding triplet

adjudication.R512_PROGRESS: R256-R512 RMSE is smaller than R128-R256 RMSE.
adjudication.R512_NO_PROGRESS: R256-R512 RMSE is not smaller than R128-R256 RMSE.
adjudication.R1024_TWO_NEW_STEP_PROGRESS: R1024 qualifies and both R256-R512 < R128-R256 and R512-R1024 < R256-R512.
adjudication.ORDER_STABILIZATION: Report orders continuously; do not convert to pass/fail with a post-selected numeric threshold.
adjudication.CONTINUUM_AUTHORITY: Not automatically granted by any monotone sequence in C5E.

next_logic.if_two_new_decreases_and_order_strengthe: Reference refinement has stronger empirical support, but a continuum claim still requires explicit resolution/temporal-error reconciliation before using the finest grid as scientific truth.
next_logic.if_decreases_continue_with_order_near_ze: Treat convergence as extremely slow/non-asymptotic; investigate why the prescribed-head discretization exhibits near-zero apparent order before extending brute-force resolution further.
next_logic.if_R512_or_R1024_breaks_monotonicity: Reference spatial behavior remains non-asymptotic; stop brute-force extension and inspect discretization/boundary formulation of Reference Richards.
next_logic.no_outcome: No LARE or closure admission is authorized by C5E.
